sampling.coarse_transform: same generated 240-Hz fine path; y120[j]=y240[2j]; no regeneration or added filtering

alias.certificate: For an underdamped C candidate, damped frequency < fn <= 45 Hz < 60 Hz; independently verify discrete pole angle in (0,pi) and candidate frequency remains in frozen domain.
alias.refuse: demonstrated observational equivalence from distinct admissible continuous lineages
alias.need_more_info: required alias certificate unavailable or unresolved

profile_I.role: resolution-bounded practical uniqueness/interiority screen only; not precision and not family membership
profile_I.true_chi: validation-only; never enters eligibility grid, starts, refinement, tie decision, or row label
profile_I.method: L-BFGS-B nuisance optimization at each chi
profile_I.start_recipe: continuation + projected global + recurrence when available + six fixed source starts
profile_I.refinement: bounded chi refinement of every base-grid local-minimum bracket and endpoint-adjacent minimum; reoptimize nuisance parameters at every chi
profile_I.selection: compare every refined candidate and endpoint under frozen numerical tie tolerance
profile_I.pass: unique lowest refined candidate is interior and reproduces fitted optimum within numerical-only tolerance
profile_I.need_more_info: edge/tied/nonregular/failed refinement unless N already classifies pure numerical refusal

observation.F09: same latent C path multiplied separately by positive gains 0.7 and 1.4; preserving transform
observation.L09: two latent modes observed through the frozen 1:0.35 normalized mixture; non-preserving for one-scalar local attribution

retention_floor.rule: FRAMEWORK_NOT_OPERATIONAL if any control-rate cell has zero QUALIFICATION_ELIGIBLE rows among its 16 fixed replicates
retention_floor.interpretation: existence/operability only; not prevalence or performance threshold

reporting.rate_summaries: 240 and 120 Hz reported separately with n=16

framework_not_operational: any required channel would need outcome-driven rule invention or retuning
semantic and estimator refusal namespaces cannot remain separate
any F01/F02 control-rate cell has zero QUALIFICATION_ELIGIBLE rows among 16 fixed replicates
a post-result scientific threshold would be required to produce ordinary eligibility
